# get_number_of_pages { #mofography.data.get_number_of_pages }

```python
data.get_number_of_pages(url, headers, params)
```

Get the number of pages of the result, from the url, for a given set of headers and parameters

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description               | Default    |
|---------|--------|---------------------------|------------|
| url     | string | url for MOFDb for example | _required_ |
| headers | dict   | dictionary of headers     | _required_ |
| params  | dict   | dictionary of parameters  | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                   |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------|
|        | int    | number of pages in the result |
